descriptions.en: Optional aspect prefix with trailing space; empty string when unused

descriptions.en: The persona in one phrase, e.g. A white-robed sword immortal

inputs.name: reference_mist_block
examples: A soft-mist filter with a faint old-film glow, as if viewed through a thin veil — contours never fully sharp, warm green and pale pink bleeding into each other, a watery vapor feel, pearl-soft highlights, a quiet, ambiguous, elusive maidenly emotion, the reserved grace of classical Eastern femininity.
